verdict.rationale: Convex supports agent-driven schema changes via CLI/MCP dev deployments (schema pushed live on file change, MCP tools for agents, and MCP blocked from production by default for safety), which gives a dev-vs-production separation but no evidence of a true git-branch-like or preview-environment workflow for isolated schema testing. missing for 10: explicit preview/branch deployment feature for schema changes, documentation of an agent workflow to create/test schema in an isolated branch before merging to production, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
